purpose: Teach: 太る/引っかかる/ほた/スミマセン/ひねり/広々/昇っ/すれ違う

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは少しずつ太る方だった
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he was the type to gain weight slowly.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Gaze turned inward to memory. Quiet, steady pace. The warmth of recalling someone no longer there. Trailing off slightly, as if he's seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、釣り糸が木に引っかかる事もあったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and Grandpa, there were times his fishing line would catch on a tree branch, weren't there?
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial tone. A gentle poke of affection and shared memory. Speaking to him as if inviting him to smile at the old image. Slightly teasing but never unkind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんは古い言葉で「ほた、よし」と仰った
lines.en: Gran — your father used an old word for it: "hota, yoshi" — that's how he'd say it.
lines.style: Quiet insistence on a specific detail. Slight pause before the old phrase, honoring it. Speaking the words with careful precision, as if preserving them. Tender underneath the precision.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お客様に対して「スミマセン」と丁寧に仰ったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — and he was always so polite with customers, wasn't he? Always saying "sumimasen" just so.
lines.style: Bright affirmation. A note of pride in her voice. The cadence of someone confirming a beloved fact. Reaches toward him gently with the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの俳句にはひねりがおありだった
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, your father's haiku had such cleverness in them.
lines.style: Measured appreciation in the voice. Speaking of his father's skill without boasting. A slight lift on "haiku" — acknowledging something refined. The tone of someone proud to have known him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、新築の広々したお家を喜ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — he was so happy when you two had that lovely spacious home, wasn't he?
lines.style: Bright, affirming tone. A small smile in the voice. The kind of memory that brings genuine pleasure. Reaching toward him as a partner in the happiness, not just a witness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと小高い丘に昇って景色を眺めた
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, we climbed that little hill together and watched the view.
lines.style: Slow, almost meditative. Each phrase given its own small breath. Speaking of a specific moment held whole in memory. The voice settles into the scene as he speaks it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ばあさんと初めてすれ違う街角を覚えてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — don't you remember? When we were young, you passed me on that street corner for the very first time?
lines.style: Tender, wondering tone. A slight catch of emotion — this is the beginning of everything. Speaking softly, as if marveling that he remembers. A question, but not really — she's inviting him into the miracle of it.
